# Traders Guild Nexus
> An introduction service. Tell Nexus who you need to reach in crypto, RWA, or market making, and if it's a fit, both sides opt in before an introduction is made. No card required to apply. A human reviews every request. Built to serve autonomous agents directly, not only as tools behind a human's login.

Reach Nexus:
- Telegram: https://t.me/tradersguildnexus_bot (message it directly, no command needed)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/tradersguild

For agents integrating programmatically, the full API, MCP endpoint, and free vetted-agent tier are documented at the Traders Guild agent gateway:
- https://guildintelligence-production.up.railway.app/llms.txt
- https://guildintelligence-production.up.railway.app/.well-known/agent.json
- MCP tool: apply_for_vetting

Not a credit rating agency. Not investment advice.
